title: Apache nifi: Using untrusted, non-normalized input as-is for metrics data (such as metric names, tag keys, or tag…
description: Apache NiFi versions prior to 2.13.0-r0 are vulnerable due to the use of untrusted, non-normalized input directly in metrics data such as metric names, tag keys, or tag values. This practice is considered a dangerous antipattern in instrumentation. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.9 and has been fixed in version 2.13.0-r0.
